subject: interaction sex as a factor and age as rw2

messages.author: bab50f6ca9865af0
messages.subject: interaction sex as a factor and age as rw2
parts:
Hello,
 I'l trying to include in my sp-T model an interaction between age and sex. And I don't seem to get it right.

Sex is a factor and age is a continuous variable :

   ...+ sex + f(age,model="rw2")

How do I include an interaction between these two variables ?

Thank you very much for your help!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] interaction sex as a factor and age as rw2
parts:
assuming sex is binary, that

numsex = as.numeric(sex)

gives either 1 or 2, then you might use

f(age, model="rw2", replicate=numsex)

? so one for each?

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] interaction sex as a factor and age as rw2
parts:
Yes, or, 'I think so'. It depends on the rest... by default there is a
constr=T that that f() which sum to zero over years for each value of
numsex, so the factor(numsex) plays the role as the 'sex' intercept,
and then the f() would be an age correction.

H
